prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished background artwork for a Sony PSP .PTF theme, wide 480:272 composition, render high resolution around 2048x1152.
Primary request: KP Aero — Vibrant Blue. Create an exceptionally polished original Frutiger Aero / Windows Vista era abstract wallpaper that matches a cobalt blue PSP shell.
Scene and subject: deep luminous cobalt-to-navy atmospheric glass space, elegant intertwined translucent azure and turquoise glass ribbons with pearlescent silver edge highlights. The ribbons originate outside the lower left border and flow predominantly along the bottom edge into an elegant fluid sculptural loop on the lower RIGHT. Very subtle refractive bubbles in the far right only. Satin depth, fresh air, clean professional 2006 wallpaper aesthetics, luminous yet restrained.
CRITICAL FUNCTIONAL COMPOSITION: the left 65 percent and central horizontal menu lane from 25 to 65 percent of image height must be dark calm navy/blue gradient with almost no detail, so a handheld's small white menu labels remain clearly legible. Upper right 20 percent is also calm darker blue for clock and battery. Main glass artwork on the far right and bottom edges, not crossing the central left text area. Reflections are smooth, not grainy; crisp flowing silhouettes at small size. No panel rectangles, no interface, no icons, no visible grid, no photography, no device frame, no logos, no lettering, no text, no watermark. Full bleed wide wallpaper, no margins.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished wallpaper artwork for a Sony PSP .PTF theme, 480:272 wide composition, high resolution around 2048x1152.
Primary request: Eesti Retro — 80–90ndad. Original premium nostalgic Estonian retro music artwork combining Tallinn autumn evening, blue glass, warm amber studio light and 1980s music technology.
Scene: midnight blue gradient atmosphere, a very faint Tallinn-inspired medieval rooftops silhouette restricted to the distant bottom horizon, amber autumn glow at bottom right, a beautifully rendered transparent smoky-blue compact audio CASSETTE with two recognisable reel windows and fine brushed silver details, angled three-quarter view, situated ONLY in the lower right quarter. It should be partly cropped at the bottom/right edge so it feels like wallpaper art rather than a catalog product. A narrow glassy light ribbon curves along the bottom, with one or two autumn leaves at the far right. Estonian blue-black-white colour hints, silver, rich restrained amber. Elegant glossy Frutiger Aero materials married to 1980s cassette nostalgia. Extremely clean, high quality render, smooth gradients, no grain.
CRITICAL PSP LAYOUT: left 65 percent and central menu lane from 25 to 68 percent of image height is a dark, quiet navy gradient with no buildings, cassette, leaves or bright details behind the future white menu labels. Upper right stays calm dark for the PSP clock and battery. All identifiable objects live at far right/bottom edges. No writing on the cassette. NO text, titles, logos, flags with writing, menu UI, icons, device frame, watermark, borders. Full bleed wallpaper.

Bubblegum glass and pearlescent candy materials with physically plausible refraction, crisp smooth specular reflections. A balanced sculpture of a few different sized spheres collected mainly in the lower RIGHT corner and at the bottom edge. Lavender-blue-to-periwinkle atmospheric gradient, subtle dreamy depth; refined 2000s personal technology aesthetic, silky and fresh. No real sweets, no food, no hard sharp objects.

It must be sufficiently dark, not white, pastel colour is concentrated in the glass artwork at right and bottom. Upper right dark purple gradient area for the clock and battery. No spheres or bright refraction across future left/center menu labels. Avoid too many objects, visual noise, grain, cartoon outlines, harsh neon, sparkles. NO text, no logos, no icons, no interface or menu screenshot, no device frame, no borders, no watermark. Full bleed wallpaper.
